title: Besu production (QBFT)
description: Validators and RPC nodes of the production QBFT network

panels.title: Seconds since last block
panels.description: Red when no block for 3 x the block period: fewer than the quorum of validators is online.

panels.title: Validators up
panels.description: QBFT needs ceil(2n/3) validators online to produce blocks (4 validators: 3).

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per Besu node. Peers should be (number of nodes - 1).

panels.title: Seconds since last block
panels.description: Age of the node's newest block when it was scraped. Stays below about 1 block period when healthy.

panels.title: Transaction pool
panels.description: Pending transactions. Steady growth means blocks are not keeping up or nonces have gaps.

panels.title: Transactions in selected range
panels.description: Transactions mined during the time range selected at the top of the dashboard.

panels.title: Last 24 hours
panels.description: Needs 24 h of Prometheus history; less is counted until then.

panels.title: Transactions per interval
panels.description: Transactions mined per bar. The bar width follows the zoom: 1 minute at most, wider for long ranges (the 'Interval' shown when hovering the panel's info).

panels.title: Cumulative transactions in range
panels.description: Running total from the start of the selected range.

panels.title: Refused connections (node allowlist)
panels.description: Connection attempts from nodes not in permissions_config.toml.

panels.title: Senders (proxy)
panels.description: Per sender of the proxy. Mined = STALLED: transactions are ready in the RPC node's pool but blocks do not include them (restart one validator). Nonce gap: a missing nonce blocks later transactions; the proxy repairs it once the chain moved on for 30 s / 10 blocks.

panels.title: Transactions in flight (proxy)
panels.description: Sent by the proxy, not confirmed yet. Should fall back to ~0 after a burst.

panels.title: Not mined / gap (seconds)
panels.description: How long ready transactions have waited with nothing confirmed, and how long a nonce gap has existed.
